# Knowledge Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/KnowledgeLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The graded epistemic depth of a knowledge-proficiency — an OPEN, ordered value vocabulary ([`knowledgeAware`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeAware.md) ≺ [`knowledgeKnowsAbout`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeKnowsAbout.md) ≺ [`knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md) ≺ [`knowledgeMastered`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeMastered.md)), the kernel [`GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) pattern. Ordinally parallels the flat knowledge spectrum ([`gmeow:isAwareOf`](../properties/gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](../properties/gmeow-hasMastered.md)) but as reusable values on the reified relator. [`gmeow:deeperThan`](../properties/gmeow-deeperThan.md) is transitive ON LEVELS ONLY; the boundaries are deliberately vague (only the order is asserted).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the depth role of a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relator — the ordinal rung (aware ≺ knows-about ≺ understands ≺ mastered) read on the native [`gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth`](../individuals/gmeow-scaleKnowledgeDepth.md), the reified parallel of the flat spectrum.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-level subclasses (levels are individuals, the kernel [`GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) idiom) and avoid reading the order as crisp cutoffs; only the order is asserted, the boundaries are deliberately vague. Reach for the generic [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) only when rating on a non-knowledge framework.

### How to use

- Reference the four seeded [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) individuals from [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md), order them with [`gmeow:deeperThan`](../properties/gmeow-deeperThan.md), and read [`gmeow:pairsWith`](../properties/gmeow-pairsWith.md) to tie each to its flat-spectrum sibling; extend with new individuals if a domain needs a finer rung.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md) a [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md); [`gmeow:deeperThan`](../properties/gmeow-deeperThan.md) [`gmeow:knowledgeKnowsAbout`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeKnowsAbout.md).
